call_points.text: A single large fire loss cost ₹12.4 Cr on the net account in the quarter.
No provision taken for the Supreme Court housewife-claim ruling; a review petition is pending.
Ind AS implementation deferred to April 1, 2027 under IRDAI forbearance; no impact estimate yet.
Industry CAT losses estimated at ₹3,000-4,000 Cr; pricing correction likely only at next reinsurance renewal.
Health degrowth reflects pricing corrections in the PSU bank group platform and migration to retail.
Management targets 15%+ ROE medium-to-long term but gave no combined-ratio guidance.
FY26 combined ratio 115.2%, or 112.2% without the 1/n effect, including motor TP reserving augmentation.
EOM for the full year was 30.46%, or 29.12% without 1/n; FY26 was the last year of the glide path.
Loss of crop insurance after re-tender cut Q4 GDPI by ₹124 Cr and the year by over ₹590 Cr.
Motor OD pricing corrected 7-8% in the last 2-3 months; OD loss ratio expected to fall over the next 6 months.
Solvency fell to 1.96x from 2.18x; no dividend taken so capital stays in the business.
Board decided to seek forbearance for moving statutory accounting to Ind AS from April 1, 2027.
Rajive Kumaraswami takes over as MD from Suryanarayanan effective June 1.

Bring motor OD loss ratio below 80%, first into the high-70s then mid-70s over time
Implement Ind AS / IFRS framework effective April 1, 2027 under IRDAI forbearance

operating_notes.text: Chola MS motor market share 5.25% in FY26, with OD share at 5.89% and TP share down about 0.5%.
Premium received in advance on long-term non-motor products rose to about ₹570 Cr at March 2026 from ₹250 Cr a year earlier.
Retail retention on a weighted basis is about 78% and blended retention about 72%.
Motor is about 70% of Chola MS's book; private cars 48%, commercial vehicles 42.5% and two-wheelers 9.5% of the motor portfolio.
Chola MS combined ratio was 115.2% in FY2026 versus 110% in FY2025; industry combined ratio 117.8% versus 112.6%.
Industry CAT loss impact from June events estimated at ₹3,000-4,000 Cr; reinsurance pricing correction expected at the next renewal cycle.
